about: Every flow the example apps show, in order, with what each step does and why. Three flows per kind, each in a different app and motion style. The page's flow player, the board's rows and the screenshots all read this file.

flows.title: The opening
flows.summary: Four beats of kinetic type on one stage, the button only on the last.

steps.name: Run at your pace
steps.note: One hero carries every beat: the volt lane. RUN slams in, your pace ticks down to 5:42, the plans from a book are struck through, and week one is built from your last run. The lane opens into the button on the last beat.

flows.title: The opening
flows.summary: A mascot, one phrase, and a microphone you hold before anything is asked.

steps.name: Say it out loud
steps.note: Tazza pops in once and carries the beats. The hands-on moment is real: a finger holds the mic and the phrase lights word by word. Only the last beat has a button.

flows.title: The opening
flows.summary: A camera, not a slideshow: the crumb, the jar, the rise, the plan.

steps.name: Bread on its own clock
steps.note: Fades in on the crumb in a letterbox as the lights come up, the first line rising out of its mask; the camera tilts down to the jar, which carries three beats: fed, rising while the clock flows, today’s peak. The plan, then the button.

flows.title: Questions to a plan
flows.summary: Five quick answers, each one reused, flowing into the plan.

steps.name: What would you change?
steps.note: Four picture cards, one pick, no paragraphs. The colour floods from the finger, the screen moves on by itself, and the flooded card pours into the next screen’s glass.

steps.name: Where you are, where you’d like to be
steps.note: Two values on one liquid gauge. The pace is theirs, half a kilo a week, and so is the date it lands on.

steps.name: Foods you’d never give up
steps.note: Real photos to pick from. The plan keeps every one of them, and says so: nothing is banned. Each pick gets a heart that follows the food through the plan.

steps.name: How your days go
steps.note: Pictures of a day instead of a quiz: four rows, each a thin strip of the day with its meals on it. The strip they pick flies into the plan.

steps.name: Your plan
steps.note: Each answer flies into the plan card and becomes its value. The curve is an estimate from their own numbers, and says so in small print.

flows.title: Questions to week one
flows.summary: A ruler, a week, a race: three answers that become three runs.

steps.name: Your longest run
steps.note: A ruler you drag. It follows the finger, the number flows, and the laps and week one’s easy runs change as you drag.

steps.name: The days you can run
steps.note: The seven days of week one, from today, as lanes; a preset lights its days in a wave, each landing on the beat.

steps.name: What you’re training for
steps.note: Four big tiles, one pick, and the screen moves on. The pick slams in.

steps.name: Week one
steps.note: The answers become three runs on the days they chose: the easy runs from their longest run, the long run from the race.

flows.title: Questions to the month
flows.summary: Two names, two incomes, one way to split, then a month that adds up.

steps.name: Who’s in
steps.note: Names are the one thing worth typing, so they are typed on the keyboard: Mia, next, Sam. Two people, two avatars, nothing else on the screen.

steps.name: What comes in
steps.note: Two take-home pays, dragged along one scale. As they land, one bar splits exactly 53 to 47 and the total rolls to £4,630. Nothing overshoots.

steps.name: How you split
steps.note: Three ways to split, each drawn as the bar it makes from their own incomes. The answer is the button.

steps.name: The month
steps.note: Each answer glides into its row, 170 ms apart, then one check on the mark. £4,630 in, £4,218 out, £412 put away.

flows.title: The paywall
flows.summary: Tonight first, then every price, then the reminder the trial promised.

steps.name: Tonight
steps.note: One value beat before the price, made from their answers: wind down at 10:50, lights out at 11:10. Nothing is invented.

steps.name: Every price
steps.note: Both prices before any tap; the trial as a timeline with real dates; one button that names the outcome; Restore and how to cancel under it.

steps.name: The reminder
steps.note: The timeline promised a reminder, so notifications are asked for here, with the date on screen. The real system alert, its real words.

steps.name: All set
steps.note: The first screen of the product, breathing slowly: tonight’s wind-down, the sound, the time.

flows.title: The paywall
flows.summary: Their first week of meals is the value, and it carries into the price.

steps.name: Your first week
steps.note: The value is their own week of meals, starting with pasta tonight and built from the foods they kept. The plates fly up into a strip on the next screen.

steps.name: Every price
steps.note: Both prices visible, the trial on a timeline with real dates, the week of meals still on screen. One button.

steps.name: Today
steps.note: After paying, the plan working: three plates fly down from the week into today’s meals, and a glass of water fills as it is logged.

flows.title: The paywall
flows.summary: Dark and loud, still honest: both prices, the trial, then Health in context.

steps.name: Week one
steps.note: The plan is the value beat: three runs built from their answers, before any price.

steps.name: Week one free
steps.note: Both prices on screen, the trial on a timeline, cancel in Settings in plain words. Loud type, no countdown, no struck-out price.

steps.name: Apple Health
steps.note: The permission is asked where its reason is visible: runs from the watch land in week one. The toggle opens the real sheet.

flows.title: The microphone
flows.summary: The phrase first, then the ask, then the first word heard.

steps.name: Your first phrase
steps.note: The phrase comes first, so the reason for the microphone is on screen before anything is asked.

steps.name: Asked in context
steps.note: The real system alert with its real text. Then the mic squishes under the finger and each word lights as it is heard.

steps.name: Day one
steps.note: Tazza cheers, once. A daily reminder is asked for with the streak on screen, at the time they practise.

flows.title: The first plant
flows.summary: One photo, a name, a schedule that grows in, and the shelf.

steps.name: Add your first plant
steps.note: The camera, with a frame that says what to do. One plant, one photo; the shutter is the only button.

steps.name: It’s a monstera
steps.note: The plant is named, and its care grows in as a schedule: water every 9 days, bright, indirect light, and repot in spring.

steps.name: Your shelf
steps.note: The product: the plant on its shelf, the next watering, a drop that fills. It sways; it never bounces.

flows.title: The first bake
flows.summary: One question, the day drawn as a schedule, one coach mark.

steps.name: Your last feed
steps.note: Time flows: the last feed on a ribbon of minutes under one needle, never a slot machine. The answer comes back as the hour it should peak.

steps.name: Your bake
steps.note: The day drawn as the schedule it is. Notifications are asked for with the peak time on screen.

steps.name: Today
steps.note: The product, like a magazine: today’s bake with its photos, and a single coach mark on the peak.

flows.title: Leaving, for budget
flows.summary: Seven screens, from the plan to coming back a month later.

steps.name: Your plan
steps.note: Where people expect it: the plan, its price, the next charge, who bills it. What it did for them comes first, in Fern’s own picture.

steps.name: One question
steps.note: Four answers in Fern’s words, no Other. One tap answers it.

steps.name: One offer
steps.note: Budget gets the whole menu once: every price visible, the best value picked. Continue to cancel is a full button.

steps.name: What stays
steps.note: Their numbers, what stays, what stops, and the exact day it stops.

steps.name: Apple’s sheet
steps.note: The platform does the cancelling, in its own sheet and its own words. Never faked inside the app.

steps.name: Goodbye
steps.note: Their name, the exact date, no more charges, what they keep, and one tap to undo.

steps.name: Coming back
steps.note: A month later: the plants are still there, every price is visible, one tap to start again.

flows.title: Leaving, for another app
flows.summary: No offer for someone who has moved on: their data, in one tap.

steps.name: One question
steps.note: Halves’ own answers, no Other. They pick “We moved to another app”.

steps.name: Take it with you
steps.note: Pretending an offer will help is slop. Their months, exported in one tap, as a spreadsheet or a statement.

steps.name: Goodbye
steps.note: Both names, the exact day, what stays readable, and the way back.

flows.title: Leaving, for a break
flows.summary: A break the App Store allows: renewal off, phrases kept, a reminder.

steps.name: One question
steps.note: Parla’s own answers. They pick “I’m taking a break”.

steps.name: A break
steps.note: The App Store can’t pause a plan, so the honest version: renewal off, every phrase kept, a reminder on the day they pick.

steps.name: Ci vediamo
steps.note: Tazza waves, once. The exact date, what stays, one tap to undo.
